name: HeightSortChain
description: Height sorting on a chain transfer: short boxes go straight on, medium ones right, tall ones left, nine boxes.

local.name: State
local.comment: One state per step: 0 idle, 1 wait for a box, 2 straight on (short), 3 lift, 4 slide sideways, 5 lower

local.name: Dir
local.comment: Where the box goes: 0 short (straight), 1 medium (right), 2 tall (left)

local.name: SawLow
local.comment: The box broke the low beam

local.name: SawHigh
local.comment: The box broke the high beam

local.name: Stand
local.comment: A box must stand still against the blade before anything moves

local.name: Clear
local.comment: Time for a short box to cross the module

local.name: Lifted
local.comment: A moment at the top before the module slides a box

local.name: Slide
local.comment: Time to slide a box off the module

inputs.name: Low
inputs.comment: BeamLow.detect: the low beam (0.25 m) is broken

inputs.name: High
inputs.comment: BeamHigh.detect: the high beam (0.35 m) is broken

inputs.name: AtBlade
inputs.comment: EyeBlade.detect: a box waits against the blade

inputs.name: Raised
inputs.comment: Chain1.raised: the chain module is up

inputs.name: Lowered
inputs.comment: Chain1.lowered: the chain module is down

outputs.name: RunChain
outputs.comment: Chain1.run: run the chain module surface

outputs.name: MoveRight
outputs.comment: Chain1.right: slide the chain module right

outputs.name: MoveLeft
outputs.comment: Chain1.left: slide the chain module left

outputs.name: RunStraight
outputs.comment: Straight.run: run the belt to the short bin

outputs.name: RunRight
outputs.comment: RightBelt.run: run the belt to the medium bin

outputs.name: RunLeft
outputs.comment: LeftBelt.run: run the belt to the tall bin

outputs.name: Hold
outputs.comment: Blade1.extend: the blade holds the box while true

outputs.name: Done
outputs.comment: Beacon.green: all nine boxes are handled
